title: Synthesis and non-isothermal crystallization kinetics of polyamide 66 copolymers containing alicyclic structures
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,2900-2911
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08482A, Paper

Weijian Lu, Chunhua Wang, Yong Yi, Mingxi Liao, Jianlin Li, Wenzhi Wang
PA66/MACM6 copolymers with alicyclic structures were synthesized, and the influence of MACM6 content on their thermal properties, mechanical properties and non-isothermal crystallization kinetics was systematically investigated.
